title: Fullstack Developer & Frontend Lead
summary: Led the frontend of an AI chat tool for lawyers: legal case documents were loaded into it, and lawyers could prompt and talk to them.
highlights: Led frontend development of the chat experience with React, Context API and Styled Components.
Integrated Azure AD B2C sign-in and authorization for an enterprise audience.
Worked with the backend team on the Flask services running on Azure, and on PostgreSQL integration.
Containerized the app with Docker for consistent deployments.
growth: My first lead role, and my first production product built on large language models.
